## Change guides

### ゲームルールを変更する

- Inspect: `packages/game-core`, `packages/content`, `packages/test-kit`
- Required checks: `npm run test --workspace @discord-hero/game-core`, `npm run agent:smoke`

### 通信形式を変更する

- Inspect: `packages/protocol`, `apps/activity/src/client/network`, `apps/activity/src/worker`
- Required checks: `npm run test --workspace @discord-hero/protocol`, `npm run test --workspace @discord-hero/activity`

### 永続化を変更する

- Inspect: `migrations`, `packages/protocol/src/persistence.ts`, `apps/activity/src/worker/persistence`, `apps/activity/src/worker/queue`
- Required checks: `npm run db:migrate:local`, `npm run test --workspace @discord-hero/activity`

### クライアント表示を変更する

- Inspect: `apps/activity/src/client`
- Required checks: `npm run typecheck --workspace @discord-hero/activity`, `npm run build --workspace @discord-hero/activity`

### アセットを追加または保管方法を変更する

- Inspect: `assets`, `packages/assets`, `scripts/assets`, `apps/activity/src/client/assets`
- Required checks: `npm run assets:validate`, `npm run assets:prepare:local`, `npm run typecheck --workspace @discord-hero/activity`
